description: Minimal capability for the main window and the Phase 3 debug-db window. Only Tauri's core defaults are granted (needed for the debug window to receive Phase 4 provider_event pushes via event.listen); no shell, no filesystem, no dialog, no HTTP plugin permissions are exposed to the frontend. All db_*, detect_claude_code, run_claude_code and the four Phase 2 commands are plain Rust functions, not plugin commands, so they need no extra permission entries here regardless of window — the frontend can only ever call those exact names.
